strongest_angle: Architecture firm HKS implemented a people-first workplace optimization model for their new Washington, D.C. office and studio, incorporating direct employee feedback and spatial design.

key_facts.fact: Architecture firm HKS operates a global design company with more than two dozen offices worldwide.
HKS designers partnered with consulting firm McKinley Advisors to reimagine their Washington, D.C. office space following COVID-19 closures.
Architecture firm HKS designed a sustainable, tech-forward hub for client Gen in Mountain View, California, completed in December 2023.
